1. SYNOPSIS > Study Design and Methodology:

Phase 1 is a multicenter, open-label, dose-ranging/dose-escalating study that will enroll up to 18 subjects.

A 3+3 design will be used for sequential dose-escalation cohorts in which subjects will receive a single subretinal injection of OCU410 in the study eye on Day 1.

The assessments and measurements will be performed according to the Schedule of Assessments (Table 3).

Subjects are considered to have completed this study if they complete the End of Study (EOS) visit at month 12 after administration of IP. The study duration will be approximately 15 months for each subject (Screening through EOS visit).

Subjects randomized to the control group will be offered the opportunity to receive the study drug following database lock.

After the Phase 2 portion of the study has been unblinded and the full complement of safety and efficacy results have been evaluated, subjects in the control group may, at the discretion of the sponsor, enroll in an expansion protocol and receive the OCU410 treatment, provided they still meet all study eligibility criteria.

1. SYNOPSIS > The following algorithm will be followed for dose-escalation Phase 1 study:

Cohort 1 Low Dose (2.5x1010 vg/mL): 3 subjects will receive a subretinal injection 200 uL of OCU410 low dose concentration. The Data and Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) will review 2 weeks of safety data post-dosing and if none of the 3 subjects on low dose concentration are determined by the DSMB to have a dose-limiting toxicity (DLT), then the dose will be escalated to medium dose concentration for the next cohort. In the event of a DLT, the algorithm of DLT (de-escalation or addition of 3 subjects) will be followed.

1. SYNOPSIS > 1 of 3 results will occur from the 3 subjects: > 1 of 3 results will occur from the 3 subjects: > 4. Fundus autofluorescence (FAF) imaging shows: > Sample Size Justification:

Assuming a two-sided alpha level of 10%, a sample size of up to 51 subjects in the expansion phase (n=17 in each of the two OCU410 dose groups and n=17 in the control group) provides 80% power to detect a 50% slowing of the GA rate in the study eye at 1 year. The GA growth rate in the control group and in each of the OCU410 dose groups were assumed to be 0.33 mm/yr, 0.165 mm/yr, and 0.165 mm/yr, respectively (SD = 0.2). The maximum total sample size across the study is 60 subjects.
